description: Read and manage Stripe customers, products, prices, payment intents, invoices, subscriptions, balance, balance transactions and events on dashboard.stripe.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Stripe Dashboard session.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the current Stripe account information including business name, email, country, and default currency. Reads from the page bootstrap data for instant response.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List customers in your Stripe account. Returns customers sorted by creation date (newest first). Use starting_after for cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific customer by their ID.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Create a new customer in your Stripe account.

tools.name: update_customer
tools.description: Update an existing customer. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: delete_customer
tools.description: Permanently delete a customer and all their subscriptions and payment sources. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: search_customers
tools.description: Search customers using Stripe search syntax. Example queries: "email:'test@example.com'", "name:'John'", "metadata['key']:'value'".

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List products in your Stripe account. Returns products sorted by creation date (newest first). Use starting_after for cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific product by its ID.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a new product. Products describe the specific goods or services you offer to your customers.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Update an existing product. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: list_prices
tools.description: List prices in your Stripe account. Optionally filter by product. Returns prices sorted by creation date (newest first).

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific price by its ID.

tools.name: create_price
tools.description: Create a new price for a product. Prices define how much and how often to charge for a product.

tools.name: list_payment_intents
tools.description: List payment intents in your Stripe account. Returns payment intents sorted by creation date (newest first).

tools.name: get_payment_intent
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific payment intent by its ID.

tools.name: search_payment_intents
tools.description: Search payment intents using Stripe search syntax. Example queries: "status:'succeeded'", "customer:'cus_xxx'", "amount>1000".

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices in your Stripe account. Returns invoices sorted by creation date (newest first).

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific invoice by its ID.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a new draft invoice for a customer. After creation, add invoice items and then finalize it.

tools.name: finalize_invoice
tools.description: Finalize a draft invoice, transitioning it to open status. After finalization, the invoice can be sent to the customer or paid automatically.

tools.name: void_invoice
tools.description: Void an open invoice. The invoice will be marked as void and no payment will be collected.

tools.name: search_invoices
tools.description: Search invoices using Stripe search syntax. Example queries: "status:'open'", "customer:'cus_xxx'", "total>5000".

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions in your Stripe account. Returns subscriptions sorted by creation date (newest first).

tools.name: get_subscription
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific subscription by its ID.

tools.name: search_subscriptions
tools.description: Search subscriptions using Stripe search syntax. Example queries: "status:'active'", "customer:'cus_xxx'".

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the current balance of your Stripe account, broken down by currency. Shows available and pending balances.

tools.name: list_balance_transactions
tools.description: List balance transactions (charges, refunds, payouts, etc.) showing how funds flow through your account.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List events in your Stripe account. Events represent changes to Stripe objects (up to 30 days). Optionally filter by event type.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific event by its ID.
